mapper.sql: n.user_id=#{userId} AND ( n.link_scrn_id IS NULL OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_info u JOIN sys.user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.use_yn='Y' JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.role_id=r.role_id AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' JOIN sys.menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id AND m.scrn_id=n.link_scrn_id AND m.use_yn='Y' WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.user_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND (u.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR u.rsgn_dt > CAST(#{now} AS date)) AND (m.scrn_id NOT IN ('UI-23','UI-24','UI-25','UI-27') OR r.admin_yn='Y') AND NOT EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS (SELECT menu_id,upr_menu_id,use_yn FROM sys.menu WHERE menu_id=m.menu_id UNION SELECT p.menu_id,p.upr_menu_id,p.use_yn FROM sys.menu p JOIN ancestors c ON p.menu_id=c.upr_menu_id) SELECT 1 FROM ancestors WHERE use_yn<>'Y') AND (r.data_scope_cd='ALL' OR (r.data_scope_cd='PART' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_part up JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON b.bsn_part_id=up.bsn_part_id AND b.use_yn='Y' WHERE up.user_id=u.user_id AND up.bsn_part_id=COALESCE(n.target_part_id,(SELECT p.bsn_part_id FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=n.target_prj_id)))) OR (r.data_scope_cd='PROJECT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_prj up JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=up.prj_id AND p.use_yn='Y' WHERE up.user_id=u.user_id AND up.prj_id=n.target_prj_id))) ))
